header: THE LITERATURE OF THE VIN, under the reader: what a VIN is and the full forms of its words, its three sections, why I, O and Q are never used, the model-year codes, the check digit, how the numbers of Indian makers differ, and what a VIN cannot tell. I made it a panel of its own (violet and indigo) so that it is not mistaken for the reading above it. All from src/tools/vin/vin.ts; nothing is stored or sent.
